name: Bench Fixture
description: The E2E bench fixture Plugin (issue #448): one on-demand Plugin whose page renders a host-owned text field that echoes every keystroke and a 1,000-row table through Remote UI, and whose Worker paints ~500 editor highlights on the focused Chapter and refreshes them on content change, so the bench:plugins and bench:frames lanes have a deterministic Plugin workload to measure.
author: Maibuk
